summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K reporting its acquisition of 51% of Rent Buddy UK Limited from Hailing Fan for a total purchase price of US$5,326,840. Payment is in three tranches: US$918,000 upon SPA execution, US$3,672,000 at closing, and US$736,840 six months post-closing. The transaction is expected to close by end of May 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. The SPA includes standard representations, indemnification, and non-compete clauses. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory clearance; risk-arb focuses on the cash payment schedule and cross-border execution.
